slides.texte_overlay:
Things every man should learn
before living alone
How to cook a few real meals. A pasta dish, a stir fry, a good omelette. Knowing three meals by heart keeps you healthy and saves you a lot of money.
How to make a simple budget. Rent, food, savings, fun. Ten minutes at the start of every month and you'll never wonder where your money went again.
How to fix small things yourself. A loose handle, a blocked sink, a flat bike tyre. Small repairs save money and give you a quiet sense of pride.
How to keep a clean home without effort. Ten minutes every evening beats a whole Sunday of cleaning. A tidy space makes your head feel tidy too.
How to keep learning on your own. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and it makes quiet evenings at home feel rich, not lonely.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. It makes quiet evenings at home feel rich, not lonely.

slides.texte_overlay: How to enjoy your own company. Cook for yourself, read, go for walks. Living alone is easy when you actually like the person you live with.
How to invite people over. A simple dinner for two or three friends. A home where people feel welcome turns a small flat into a real place to live.
